import json
from sqlalchemy import create_engine,select,func
from src.runtime import database_url
from src.outbox import outbox
from src.mongo_repository import MongoRepository
from pymongo.errors import PyMongoError
e=create_engine(database_url())
with e.connect() as c:
 total=c.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(outbox));pending=c.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(outbox).where(outbox.c.status!='delivered'))
r=MongoRepository(role='relay')
try:mongo=r.collection.count_documents({'device_id':{'$in':['alpha','beta','gamma']}})
except PyMongoError:mongo=None
finally:r.close();e.dispose()
print(json.dumps(dict(total=total,pending=pending,mongo=mongo)))
